thread:
maria gonzalez: Quick async check — we're consolidating the telemetry pieces for token-cost attribution, per-route latency breakdowns, and the new event schema. I sketched a tentative milestone list below, want owners/objections by EOD.

maria gonzalez: Milestones: 1) event schema v1 + validation (blocking downstream joins) — target 4/15; 2) ingestion pipeline (kafka -> warehouse) + partition keys — 4/22; 3) attribution join + cost model proof-of-concept — 5/5; 4) dashboards + alerting for regressions — 5/12.

alex huang: I'll take schema v1 + validation. Plan to open a PR with schema and unit tests tomorrow. Re: validation, do we want Avro/JSON schema + schema registry or a lightweight consumer-side check? lean towards schema registry for stricter guarantees.

chris p: tagging onto alex — for backwards compatibility, can we include a "version" field on events and a small migration plan? avoids breaking existing joins.

alex huang: yes — adding "schema_version" string. will include a migration section in the PR.

samir k: I can own ingestion pipeline work. Question: do we need separate topics per-customer for privacy, or a single topic with a customer_id field? Privacy-sensitive customers may ask for separate topics later.

lee (analytics): single topic + customer_id is fine for now, but put gating in the design doc so we can spin up separate topics later. also need to confirm retention policy — we'll likely keep raw token traces 7 days, aggregated/monthly rollups longer.

pat (sre): FYI, ingestion needs throttling and backpressure handling. If ingestion spikes we should auto-scale consumers and have DLQ for malformed events. I'll add an infra checklist.

alex huang: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/432 (draft). includes schema + unit tests. sample schema snippet in the PR — pasted below.

alex huang: ```json
{
  "event_type": "inference_request",
  "schema_version": "v1",
  "timestamp": 1680000000,
  "request_id": "req_abcdef123",
  "model": "redwood-3b-quant",
  "tokens": { "input": 45, "output": 120 },
  "latency_ms": 254,
  "cost_micros": 45200,
  "route": "/chat",
  "user_id": "acct_789",
  "metadata": {}
}
```

lee (analytics): Nice. Can you add a `cache_hit` boolean and `kv_bytes_saved` int? That helps attribution when prefix caching reduces token counts.

alex huang: good call — will add.

chris p: For the attribution join, we need deterministic keys: request_id + timestamp shards + route should be sufficient. Also add model_variant in case we route to fallbacks.

samir k: On partitioning, we'll partition by (date, route) to keep hot keys manageable. If someone has hot routes we can add sharding.

maria gonzalez: Owners so far: schema/validation = alex, ingestion = samir, attribution join = chris, dashboards = lee, infra checklist = pat. If anyone can't meet targets speak up now.

lee (analytics): dashboard scope note: we need per-route P99 latency, median token cost, and a regression alert when median cost rises >10% for 24h on a pinned prompt set. I'll draft queries once schema final.

pat (sre): also add alerting for consumer lag > 2x baseline and DLQ growth > 100/min.

chris p: PR reviewers: @lee, @maria, @pat. I'll schedule a quick code-review window tomorrow 10–11am to reduce turnaround.

alex huang: pinged reviewers, will push updates after feedback.

deploy-bot: canary deployment of telemetry-ingest consumer succeeded in us-east-1 — 3 replicas. :white_check_mark:

samir k: blocker: need credentials for the schema-registry instance in staging. @infra-team can you provision read/write for the telemetry-service?

pat (sre): filing infra ticket now: INFRA-7893. I'll link it in the PR.

maria gonzalez: Great. If no objections, we'll treat these milestones as tentative and update weekly on the eng-platform async thread. Please add your TODOs into the PR and link any related dashboards/queries.

lee (analytics): :eyes: will start drafting queries after schema update.

chris p: thanks all — keeping this lightweight but please call out any cross-team splits early.

maria gonzalez: Closing loop — if you volunteered above, please add yourself as an assignee on the milestone in the project board. I'll reconcile by EOD. Thanks!
